Brand Profile Revamp & Individual Video Portfolio UAE — Pricing 2026

Quick Answer

Individual video portfolio production and brand profile revamp content in the UAE starts from AED 5,000 for a professional personal brand video and rises to AED 25,000 and above for a full brand identity refresh production including hero video, social content suite, and photography. Backyard Studio creates individual video portfolios, personal brand films, executive profile videos, professional athlete profiles, and brand refresh content for individuals and businesses repositioning in the UAE market. Productions cover all seven UAE emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. Contact Backyard Studio on +971 58 588 2685.

---

What Is a Profile Revamp & Individual Video Portfolio?

A profile revamp is a professional video production specifically designed to update, refresh, and reposition an individual's or brand's visual presence and public identity — used when a person or company has grown, changed direction, or entered a new market and needs content that reflects who they are now rather than who they were when their existing content was produced.

An individual video portfolio is a curated collection of professionally produced video content documenting an individual's skills, achievements, experience, and professional identity — used by athletes, performing artists, executives, academics, consultants, architects, and creative professionals to present their work credibly to employers, clients, agents, competition committees, and media.

In the UAE, where professional reputation is heavily driven by digital presence — LinkedIn, personal websites, and Google search results — a professional video portfolio or brand refresh is an investment in first impressions at scale. A polished 90-second personal brand video on LinkedIn or a well-produced portfolio page on a personal website reaches more professional opportunities than any number of written profiles.

---

Profile Revamp & Video Portfolio Pricing in the UAE (2026)

| Package | Price (AED) | What's Included | |---|---|---| | Personal Brand Video (60–90 sec) | from 5,000 | Half-day shoot, 1 location, professional lighting, edit + colour grade, social format delivery | | Executive Profile Video | from 8,000 | Interview + b-roll at workspace/location, professional lighting + audio, 2–4 min profile video | | Individual Achievement Portfolio (3–8 min) | 12,000 – 25,000 | Full individual profile — interview, location coverage, achievement showcase, documentary style | | Athlete Video Portfolio | 10,000 – 20,000 | Training footage + interview + highlight compilation, multi-location, social reel + full portfolio version | | Brand Profile Revamp (full package) | 20,000 – 45,000 | New hero video + social content suite + photography — complete visual identity refresh | | Performing Artist Portfolio | 8,000 – 18,000 | Performance footage + interview + achievement profile — music, dance, theatre, comedy |

---

What's Included in an Individual Video Portfolio Production

Pre-production: - Portfolio strategy consultation — identifying the target audience, platform, and professional objective of the portfolio - Shot list based on skills, achievements, and environments to showcase - Location selection — office, training facility, studio, outdoor, or combination - Styling and wardrobe guidance - Interview question framework based on the individual's story and objectives

Production: - Professional camera crew with cinema-grade camera - Professional three-point lighting setup - Lapel microphone and directional audio - B-roll: workplace, training, skills in action, location context - Interview — structured and conversational, with multiple takes for natural delivery

Post-production: - Full portfolio video edit (2–8 minutes) - Short-form social version (60–90 seconds for LinkedIn and Instagram) - Colour grade - Branded lower thirds with name, title, and credentials - Music bed (licensed) - Subtitle file (English and/or Arabic) - Multi-format delivery: 16:9 (website/YouTube), 9:16 (social), 1:1 (LinkedIn)

---

Types of Profile & Portfolio Content Backyard Studio Creates

Personal brand videos: A concise 60–90 second video that introduces an individual to their professional network — who they are, what they do, who they help, and what makes them distinctive. The most widely used format for LinkedIn profile videos, speaker bureau pages, and personal website hero content. Used by executives, consultants, coaches, entrepreneurs, and any individual whose work depends on personal credibility and relationship trust.

Executive profile videos: A more detailed (2–4 minute) profile of a senior executive — combining interview with workspace and work-in-action b-roll. Used for company "About the Team" pages, keynote speaker profiles, board appointment announcements, award nomination submissions, and business publication profiles.

Individual achievement portfolios: A documentary-style video profile (3–8 minutes) documenting an individual's career achievements — most commonly produced for senior professionals transitioning between sectors, entrepreneurs announcing a new venture, and individuals seeking board or advisory appointments. The format mirrors a documentary short: structured interview, archival stills and video where relevant, and b-roll illustrating the individual's environment and work.

Athlete video portfolios: Professional video portfolios for UAE-based and visiting athletes — combining training footage, competition highlights, coach or team testimony, and an athlete interview. Used for team selection submissions, sponsorship approaches, scholarship applications, and sports media coverage. Backyard Studio has produced athlete portfolios for football, cricket, MMA, swimming, and equestrian athletes in the UAE.

Performing artist portfolios: Video portfolios for musicians, dancers, actors, stand-up comedians, and performing artists — combining performance footage with an interview contextualising the artist's background, influences, and professional achievements. Used for agency representation applications, festival programming submissions, and entertainment industry pitch materials.

Brand profile revamps: For companies whose existing video presence no longer reflects their current size, service offering, or market positioning — a full brand profile revamp production creates a new hero video, updated social content suite, and coordinated photography in a single production engagement. Common triggers for brand revamp commissions include: major service expansion, geographic market entry, leadership change, rebranding, investment announcement, and significant company milestone.

---

Profile Revamp & Portfolio Production Across UAE Emirates

Dubai: The UAE's primary professional networking market — LinkedIn activity, personal brand visibility, and executive profile credibility are most actively relevant in Dubai's DIFC, Business Bay, and DWTC professional ecosystem. Backyard Studio's individual portfolio productions in Dubai typically use the subject's own office, an DIFC or Business Bay lobby location, or an outdoor urban setting in Downtown.

Abu Dhabi: Government officials, senior public sector executives, academics (ADNEC and UAE university connections), and senior private sector figures in Abu Dhabi commission profile and portfolio productions for international conference, award submission, and government programme contexts.

Sharjah and Northern Emirates: Entrepreneurial and cultural figures based in the Northern Emirates — artists, traditional craftspeople, regional business owners, and academic professionals — are increasingly commissioning individual video portfolios as digital presence becomes essential for professional opportunity across the UAE and Gulf region.

---

Why UAE Professionals Choose Backyard Studio for Portfolio Content

Interview direction: The most common problem with professionally filmed executive portraits and profile videos is that the subject looks and sounds uncomfortable on camera — reading from notes, speaking in corporate jargon, or visibly nervous. Backyard Studio's directors are experienced in helping interview subjects relax and speak naturally, using conversational interview techniques and multiple takes to find the authentic, credible version of the individual rather than the performed one.

Understanding of professional objectives: A profile video for a keynote speaker has different requirements from a portfolio for a professional athlete, which is different from an executive profile for a private equity investment committee. Backyard Studio develops each portfolio brief around the specific professional objective — the target audience, the decision they're being asked to make, and what they need to see and hear to make it.

Dubai LinkedIn market familiarity: The UAE's professional LinkedIn market is one of the most active and business-critical in the world. Backyard Studio understands what performs on UAE LinkedIn — the visual hooks, the length, the captioning conventions, and the storytelling approach that drives profile views, connection requests, and inbound professional enquiries.

Photography and video coordination: A brand profile revamp is most effective when photography and video are produced in a single coordinated production day — consistent styling, lighting, and location across both photo and video outputs creates a unified brand presence that individual photography or video shoots produced separately cannot match. Backyard Studio coordinates photography and video content in a single brief and shoot.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a personal brand video cost in the UAE?

Personal brand video production in the UAE starts from AED 5,000 for a 60–90 second professional brand video with half-day production, one location, professional lighting and audio, edit, colour grade, and social format delivery. Executive profile videos (2–4 minutes) start from AED 8,000. A full individual achievement portfolio documentary (3–8 minutes) is priced from AED 12,000 to AED 25,000.

What is a brand profile revamp and when do I need one?

A brand profile revamp is a comprehensive update of a business's video and photography presence — new hero video, new social content suite, and updated brand photography — produced in a coordinated production to ensure visual consistency across all platforms. You likely need a brand revamp if: your existing video content is more than 2 years old, your company has significantly grown or changed services, you're entering a new market, or your leadership team has changed. Backyard Studio's brand profile revamp packages start from AED 20,000.

Can you produce an athlete video portfolio in the UAE?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces professional athlete video portfolios for UAE-based and visiting athletes across all sports — football, cricket, MMA, swimming, equestrian, golf, basketball, and others. A standard athlete portfolio production (training footage + competition highlights + interview) is priced from AED 10,000 and includes social reel cuts (60–90 seconds for Instagram) and a full portfolio version (3–5 minutes) for agency and sponsorship submissions.

Do you produce portfolio videos for performing artists?

Yes. Musicians, dancers, actors, and performing artists working in the UAE commission video portfolios for agency applications, festival submissions, and media coverage. Backyard Studio produces performing artist portfolio videos that combine performance footage (live or specially filmed) with an artist interview. Productions are priced from AED 8,000 and delivered in formats suitable for YouTube, Instagram, agent submission packages, and festival digital programmes.

How long does a personal brand video take to produce?

A personal brand video (60–90 seconds) takes 1–2 weeks from brief to delivery: pre-production consultation and shot planning (3–5 days), half-day shoot, and 3–5 days post-production. An executive profile video or full portfolio documentary takes 2–4 weeks depending on complexity and locations. Rush timelines are available for award submissions and time-sensitive professional milestones.

Can you update my brand video to reflect a new service or company direction?

Yes. Backyard Studio produces brand refresh productions for companies whose existing video content no longer accurately represents them. A targeted brand refresh — re-filming specific sections of an existing company video to reflect new services, a new team, or a new market position — is often more cost-effective than a full re-production. Backyard Studio reviews existing content before recommending a full revamp or a targeted update.

Do you produce individual video portfolios in Arabic?

Yes. Individual video portfolios and personal brand content in Arabic — for UAE national professionals presenting to Arabic-language professional networks, government bodies, or Gulf Arab business environments — are produced with Arabic-speaking directors and delivered with Arabic subtitles and captions. Arabic-language LinkedIn content for UAE national professionals significantly outperforms English-language equivalents in terms of professional network engagement.
